display_long_description:
Load a crystal. Draw your slingshot. Turn glass into a burst of color.

Step onto a sky deck above a neon city and take on an arcade challenge built for VR. Match colored crystals to glass jars, break connected groups and stop the rising stacks from reaching the danger line.

MAKE EVERY SHOT COUNT
Choose your color, control your draw and release. Cracking glass, flying shards and splashing liquid bring every successful clear to life.

PLAY FOR THE BIG CLEAR
Larger groups mean bigger scores. Fuller jars need more matching hits, forcing you to balance quick clears against valuable targets as the conveyor keeps delivering.

HANDLE THE UNEXPECTED
Rainbow jars unleash effects that can shift the pressure in an instant. Adapt your aim and strategy as the waves bring faster deliveries and tougher stacks.

OWN YOUR NEXT RUN
Push through escalating waves, chase your personal best and jump straight back in for another attempt. An original electronic soundtrack and a city alive with flying traffic and spectators surround the action.

Pull. Aim. Match. Shatter. How far can you go?
